title: Invertible modules on algebraic groups are differences of ample modules
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $H$ a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme] whose structure morphism is separated and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]; separated means that its diagonal is a closed immersion. Let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_H$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. There are ample invertible modules $A$ and $B$ on $H$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] and an isomorphism $L\simeq A\otimes_{\mathcal O_H}B^{-1}$, where $B^{-1}=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_H}(B,\mathcal O_H)$ and tensor product has its sheaf meaning [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Neither properness, smoothness, commutativity nor symmetry of $L$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0BF7, lemma-algebraic-quasi-projective; combined with morphisms.tex Tag 0FVC, lemma-invertible-add-enough-ample-very-ample (apply over Spec k and take a positive high ample twist).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-finite-type-group-ample-line] to $H$: its group structure, field base, finite type and separatedness are precisely the hypotheses. Choose an ample invertible module $M$ on $H$. By [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], $H$ is quasi-compact and every point has an affine nonvanishing neighbourhood from a section of a positive power of $M$.

source.place: Tag 0BF7, lemma-algebraic-quasi-projective; absolute ample module furnished by the cited input.

proof.text: The module $L$ is quasi-coherent by [def-sc-invertible-module], and is of finite type by [pqf-def-coherent]: on a trivializing open its single frame gives a surjection from $\mathcal O$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-twist-global-generation] with ample module $M$ and finite-type quasi-coherent module $L$. Choose a natural number $n\geq\max(0,d_0)$ such that $F=L\otimes M^{\otimes n}$ is generated by finitely many global sections. It is invertible, since locally the tensor of frames of $L$ and $M^{\otimes n}$ is a frame. Put $B=M^{\otimes(n+1)}$ and $A=M\otimes F$. Since $n+1>0$, [lem-sc-ample-positive-tensor-power] proves that $B$ is ample.

We verify ampleness of $A$ directly. Fix $x\in H$. From ampleness of $M$ choose $r\geq1$ and $s\in\Gamma(H,M^{\otimes r})$ with $x\in H_s$ and $H_s$ affine. By [lem-sc-global-generation-nonvanishing-cover] choose $t\in\Gamma(H,F)$ nonvanishing at $x$. The tensor $u=s\otimes t^{\otimes r}$ is a section of $M^{\otimes r}\otimes F^{\otimes r}\cong A^{\otimes r}$. In a local frame, a coefficient of $t^{\otimes r}$ is the $r$th power of that of $t$, so its residue is nonzero at $x$. Apply [lem-sc-tensor-section-affine-open] to $s$ and $t^{\otimes r}$: $H_u=H_s\cap H_{t^{\otimes r}}$ is affine and contains $x$. The displayed rearrangement of tensor factors preserves the locus, as is seen in the same local frames. Together with quasi-compactness of $H$, these sections give exactly the definition of absolute ampleness [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Thus $A$ is ample.

source.place: Tag 0890, lemma-ample-tensor-globally-generated, proof with m=1; the affine tensor-section locus is explicitly cited, and the remaining section construction is elementary.

proof.text: Rearranging tensor factors gives $A=M\otimes(L\otimes M^{\otimes n})\cong L\otimes B$. Evaluation gives $B\otimes\mathcal Hom(B,\mathcal O_H)\cong\mathcal O_H$: on any frame $b$ of $B$, it sends $b\otimes b^\vee$ to $1$, with inverse $1\mapsto b\otimes b^\vee$. Replacing $b$ by $vb$ replaces its dual by $v^{-1}b^\vee$, so the inverses agree on overlaps. Hence $A\otimes B^{-1}\cong L\otimes(B\otimes B^{-1})\cong L$. Inverting this isomorphism proves the required $L\cong A\otimes B^{-1}$. All three modules are invertible by their local frames; $A$ and $B$ are ample by the preceding steps.

source.place: Elementary tensor cancellation and dual evaluation in local rank-one frames, applied to the ample twists constructed using Tags 01Q3 and 0890.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 01Q3 (global generation of a high twist), Lemma 0890 proof (ampleness by affine tensor-section loci), and elementary cancellation, with existence input from Groupoids 0BF7. This gives the ample consequence of Morphisms 0FVC without needing relative very ampleness.
